name: orphograph
description: Anchor a file, folder, or agent-generated output to the Bitcoin blockchain via OpenTimestamps and get a receipt anyone can verify independently. Hashing is local — only the fingerprint crosses the wire, never the file.

custom.description: Single file, Python >=3.9 standard library only, no dependencies. Download with: curl -sSL https://orphograph.com/mcp/orphograph_mcp.py -o orphograph_mcp.py

examples.title: Prove a file existed before a deadline
examples.description: Anchor a contract draft so its existence-by-date can be checked later by someone who does not trust either party's filesystem.
examples.prompt: _Anchor ~/contracts/draft-v3.pdf and give me the receipt id_

examples.title: Anchor an agent's output at the moment it is produced
examples.description: Commit the fingerprint of a generated result so the record cannot be revised after the fact.
examples.prompt: _Anchor the report you just generated, then tell me its receipt id_

examples.title: Anchor a whole dataset under one root
examples.description: Build an RFC-6962 Merkle manifest over a directory so a single anchored root covers every file in it.
examples.prompt: _Anchor the folder ~/datasets/training-set-v2 and show me the Merkle root_

examples.title: Verify a receipt someone showed you
examples.description: Check a receipt against the OpenTimestamps calendars and the Bitcoin chain.
